prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Generate an exceptionally polished 8x social website concept plus a compact interaction storyboard, 1536x1280 landscape. This is the NEXT section after the attached video showcase, based on the original 8x website topic "Why brands are moving budget here". The reference is ONLY for typography, warm stone palette, minimal navigation and fine dot brand language. DO NOT reuse any portraits, videos or video grid. This section is about how creator networks compare with influencer campaigns and paid ads. Be intellectually clear, visually memorable, minimal and elegant, like a premium research/product company; don't copy another company's page.

Upper 76% is a single realistic desktop website screenshot. Bottom24% is a small three-state design storyboard, outside the website. Flat continuous warm stone #e9e5dc, almost-black #111111, tiny vermilion #f34b32 accent. No card containers, background panels, section divider lines, full-screen colour changes, gradients or fake3D. Immaculate typographic craft, generous breathing space, coherent horizontal alignment.

Quiet compact navbar at top: black serif '8x' and small sans 'social'; 'The network', 'How it works', 'For creators', 'Let’s talk ↗'. Then a confident large two-line sans heading left: 'Why brands move' / 'budget here.' Final period orange. To its right understated short explanatory copy: 'Creator-led content. Organic distribution. Managed by 8x.' Be generous with empty space.

Below is ONE shared interactive comparison canvas, unboxed on the SAME stone. A narrow left selector column 22%width has three simple typography choices, spaced 55px apart:
'8x network' selected bold black with one tiny orange dot before it
'Influencer campaigns' muted warmgrey
'Paid ads' muted warmgrey
No pillbuttons, no outlines, no table, no heavy rules.

The remaining 75%width is a visually exquisite EXPLANATORY DOT NETWORK, more like an architectural print than tech wallpaper. One small orange node on the left with tiny 'Your brief' label; 5 calm hairline charcoal branches emerge to a small group of dark nodes labelled 'Creators'; they fan out in a precise, subtly organic branching structure toward dozens of tiny black dots on the right labelled 'Content in circulation'. The terminal dots form an elegant soft-edged spreading field, restrained and open, not a denseblackblob. Asymmetric but balanced silhouette: narroworigin then gracefully widened rightside, radiating like a human network. More ink at the center, fine dot sizes diminish and dissolve into the stone at extremities. About200fine dots and delicate linkinglines, not thousands of particles or a hugehairball. The illustration is not a financial chart: NO axes, numbers, percentage claims, quantitative scales or bars.
Only one small group of orange dots appears near a branchingpoint, indicating a quiet travelling pulse;95%ofgraphic is charcoal. NO glowingbeams, halos, rainbow, gradients, giantcircles, disconnected decorative dots. It should explain one brief distributed through many creators, with content remaining in circulation. Elegant graphic motion frozen in one frame.

Below the diagram, aligned to it: medium-large text 'Built to keep working.' and small body 'Creator accounts and a growing library of content, managed by one team.' Below this a small orange 'Build your network ↗' textCTA. No giantstats or invented results. At very bottom ofwebsite modest comparison summary on one line: 'Original content     Creative testing     Daily management' with ample spacing, no cards orcheckmarks.

The entire website should feel like a calm continuation of the prior stone page. All content sits within consistent margins, no scrollingframe or sectionboxedstage. Strong hierarchy from heading to interactive diagram to concise benefit.

STORYBOARD below with generous whitespace and small labels:
'01 / PAID ADS' miniature of same diagramarea wheredots form precise channels between a briefnode and a tidy placementmatrix; tinycaption 'Paid placements'.
'02 / INFLUENCERS' same diagramarea reconfigures to three independent satelliteclusters; tinycaption 'Campaign partnerships'.
'03 / 8X NETWORK' same diagramarea reconfigures to the branching dotnetwork frommainscreenshot with one tinyorange pulse; tinycaption 'A managed creator network'.
All three miniatures aligned with identicalviewportbounds andbackground, NO enclosingrectangle. Use subtle small arrows between miniatures outsidewebsite. Small storyboardfooter 'The dots change. The page stays still.' This illustrates selection states rather than claiming any quantitativeperformance. Avoid implying allinfluencercampaigns have zeroorganicvalue.

Professional finished high-fidelity design. Crisp readable text. Subtle ink texture in dot graphic only. Not a generic three-card benefits section, not a SaaSdashboard, not a trophy, not abstractribbons, not a dollar symbol, no repetition of the 8xlogo asheroart. This newsection gives the eye a pause after the richvideo tapestry while preserving recognizable brandidentity.
